High Court Urges Amicable Resolution to Punjab Lawyers' Strike

The Punjab and Haryana High Court has expressed hope that a resolution will be reached amicably regarding the ongoing lawyers' strike. The strike is reportedly in protest against the Lawyers' Duty Compulsory Scheme (LADC). The court's statement indicates a desire for a peaceful conclusion to the dispute.
